title: Enes Freedom leaves WNBA Finals after sparring with police over seating change amid security concerns
author: ByJackson ThompsonOutKick
summary: Enes Kanter Freedom was directed to watch WNBA Finals Game 3 from a private suite at State Farm Arena but vowed to sit in his purchased seats.
content:
Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom tells OutKick that he is in contact with the FBI after receiving death threats over his plans to attend Game 3 of the WNBA Finals in Atlanta

Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was seen leaving State Farm Arena on Wednesday after a heated and lengthy confrontation with police at the security entrance over his seating arrangement for Game 3 of the WNBA Finals.

Prior to the game, Freedom was directed to watch Wednesday night’s WNBA Finals game from a private luxury suite with additional security after contacting authorities and basketball officials about concerns for his safety. Freedom was seen saying "I guess they'll have to drag me," in a video of a phone conversation with arena security, defying the directive.

When he arrived at the arena, he was told that if he were let in, he was told by a security officer he would have to go to the suite that was designated for him, to which Freedom aggressively protested, as seen in footage posted by Benny Johnson.

Freedom repeatedly demanded access to the seats he said he had purchased, rejecting the suite arrangement. "I purchased thousands of dollars of tickets, right? And I would like to sit on my seat. That’s all I want," he said.

An official cited both Freedom’s previously expressed safety concerns and his ejection from an earlier WNBA game as reasons for the arrangement. "For one, you expressed you were concerned about your security. You showed up here, right, with security," the official said. "So we’re saying we’re gonna make this a safe environment for you."

The exchange grew more contentious when an official referenced Freedom’s social media post about a player. Freedom defended the post as free speech. When told he was targeting people, he repeatedly demanded to know whom the official meant.

"Give me a name. Give me exactly a name," he said.

Freedom was also told he would receive a refund, but continued to reject the arrangement.

"I don’t want a refund. I would like to sit on my seat and enjoy the game," he said.

He accused those handling the encounter of bullying him and compared the proposed suite restriction to being placed in a cage.

Officers ultimately told Freedom he had to leave the property, explaining that he could go onto public streets. He eventually departed, saying, "Well, I guess you got to escort me," before walking away.

Afterward, Freedom accused the organizations involved of excluding him because of his advocacy.

"They kicked me out of the game for supporting women," he said in a conversation with Johnson. "Shame on the NBA and shame on the WNBA."

He also denied having security concerns, despite his earlier statements about threats and the explanation given during the encounter.

Asked whether he felt discriminated against, Freedom responded, "Of course, this is discrimination."

The arrangement for Game 3 between theAtlanta Dreamand Golden State Valkyries at State Farm Arena follows Freedom’s public claims that he received death threats over his planned attendance. He previously told OutKick he was in contact with the FBI and Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp's office about the threats.

State Farm Arena provided a statement to OutKick outlining the security arrangements. Freedom contacted federal, state and local authorities, along with the WNBA, the Dream and arena officials.

WNBA MOVES FINALS GAMES 3 AND 4 TO STATE FARM ARENA, GIVING ATLANTA DREAM THOUSANDS MORE SEATS

"Enes Kanter Freedom has contacted federal, state and local authorities, the WNBA, the Atlanta Dream and State Farm Arena officials to express concerns about his personal safety during his planned attendance at Game 3 of the WNBA Finals tonight. The safety and security of our guests and team members is our highest priority," the statement read."

"Following consultations with the WNBA, Dream ownership, State Farm Arena leadership and security officials, we have directed Mr. Freedom to watch tonight’s game from a private luxury suite. This arrangement is intended to address his security concerns and help provide a safe and positive experience for him and other guests. The suite will have additional security and will be his designated viewing location for the game. State police have also assigned an officer to Mr. Freedom at his request."

Freedom posted a video on X of his conversation with a security representative about the arrangements.

"I don't want a suite, I would like to to sit on the seat that I bought and purchased. I do not want a suite, I'm going to come and sit on the seats that I just bought, that's it," Freedom said when the representative informed him that he would have to sit in a suite.

The representative responded, telling Freedom, "The only thing available to you tonight is the suite."

Freedom subsequently responded, declaring, "Do you know everyone, every media that is going to hear about this right?" later adding, "I guess they'll have to drag me."

ENES KANTER FREEDOM OPENS UP ON CONFRONTATION WITH NATASHA CLOUD THAT LED TO EJECTION, WNBA PURSUIT

Freedom previously told OutKick he had received "thousands of death threats" after announcing his plans to attend, including messages warning that he would be "the next Charlie Kirk." The number of threats he described has not been independently verified.

"My DMs are full of pictures and videos of the moment that Charlie Kirk got shot," Freedom said, adding that the messages warned he would suffer the same fate. He also posted a compilation Tuesday showing messages he presented as threats against him.

Freedom said he had contacted the FBI and arranged his own security. A spokesperson for Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp separately told OutKick that the governor’s office had connected Freedom’s team with the appropriate law enforcement resources.

Despite the threats, Freedom said he intended to attend to support women’s basketball. Asked how he would respond if a player confronted him, he said he would avoid escalating the encounter and would remain off the court.

Freedom’s planned appearance comes afterhis removal from an August gamebetween theChicago Skyand Indiana Fever following a heated interaction with Sky guard Natasha Cloud. He was subsequently banned from the Chicago arena.

Former basketball player Enes Kanter Freedom poses courtside prior to the game between the Chicago Sky and the Indiana Fever at Wintrust Arena on Aug. 23, 2026, in Chicago, Ill.(Getty Images)

The former NBA center has challenged the WNBA over eligibility for transgender athletes and announced an attempt to enter its draft.

WNBA TELLS CONGRESS THAT ENES KANTER FREEDOM, ROYCE WHITE ARE ‘BOTH MEN’ IN ELIGIBILITY DISPUTE

Wednesday’s game tipped off at 8 p.m. Eastern. Atlanta and the Hawks arranged for the Dream to host Games 3 and 4 at State Farm Arena, moving the championship games from the smaller Gateway Center Arena.

title: Travelers to hot spot sternly warned by State Department as officials deny wider Gulf shutdown
author: ByJessica MeklesFox News
summary: A U.S. State Department spokesperson has debunked claims of a broad regional pullout in the Gulf region, confirming that the mandatory evacuation order is confined to Saudi Arabia.
content:
Retired Gen. Jack Keane and Jeff Smith provide analysis on Houthi rebels escalating attacks on Saudi Arabia as China is suspected of offering help.

Americans traveling in and through the Middle East have a new wrinkle to sort out.

The U.S. State Department has pushed back against circulating reports that it directed nonessential government personnel and their dependents to leavethe entire Gulf region,clarifying that the departure order applies only to Saudi Arabia.

State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott dismissed the broader regional claims, calling them "inaccurate" after the department released a formal statement confirming the targeted drawdown within the kingdom.

"The U.S. Department of State issued an ordered departure for non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia," the department said.

AMERICANS WARNED AGAINST TRAVEL PLANS AS TERRORISM THREATENS POPULAR DESTINATION

The clarification arrived amid an uptick in militant strikes aimed atkey regional transit hubs.

In the statement shared with Fox News Digital, the spokesperson noted that "Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties andsevere travel disruptions."

The U.S. State Department emphasized that the safety and security of its staff and their households in Saudi Arabia, pictured here, remain its highest priority after travelers to the region are cautioned.(iStock)

Officials warned the security environment remains highly volatile, adding the conflict "has the potential to escalate rapidly, including beyond that immediate area."

The department emphasized that the safety and security of its staff and its households remain its highest priority.

US STATE DEPARTMENT WARNS AMERICANS OF GROWING SECURITY RISKS IN HISTORIC REGION

The United States "will continue to take all necessary steps to protect and support them as they return to the U.S.," the spokesperson said.

The current security environment remains highly volatile.

In late September, the State Department renewed its warning to Americans traveling in and throughthe Middle Eastamid escalating regional tensions.

The warning came asIran-backed Houthi rebelslaunched a ballistic missile toward Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, which Saudi Arabia said its air defenses intercepted.

No casualties or damage from the attack were reported at the time.

A plume of smoke rises during a reported airstrike by the Saudi-led coalition on the Houthi-controlled Yemeni capital Sanaa, Oct. 9, 2026.

"Iranian-supported Houthis have engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including civilian airports," the post said.

"This military conflict has the potential to escalate rapidly. Americans outside the Middle East should seriouslyreconsider travelto and through the region."

The agency also advised those traveling to or from the region to monitor airport and airline operations, warning thatU.S. diplomatic facilitieshave been targeted, including outside the Middle East.

Traffic moves at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka, Bangladesh, amid flight cancellations affecting Saudi Arabia-bound travelers following reported Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia.(SOPA Images/LightRocket via Getty Images)

title: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan explains viral sideline exchange with Brock Purdy, who yelled at him during game
author: ByScott ThompsonOutKick
summary: Brock Purdy's sideline shout at Kyle Shanahan went viral, but the San Francisco 49ers coach says a helmet communication cutoff was the real issue.
content:
Brock Purdy is five pass attempts away from becoming the all-time Passer Rating leader. Nick Wright, Chris Broussard, Kevin Wildes, and Greg Jennings discuss Purdy’s ascent and what it means for the San Francisco 49ers, if the Dallas Cowboys or Green Bay Packers are really threats in the NFC, and whether or not Bo Nix’s struggles can be fixed.

TheSan Francisco 49ersare red-hot to start the 2026 season, owning a perfect 6-0 record after a "Monday Night Football" victory over the Washington Commanders.

But tensions can run high even when things are going well. Just ask head coach Kyle Shanahan and quarterbackBrock Purdyafter the latter screamed toward his leader on the sideline in a now-viral exchange in Week 6.

This page may contain affiliate links to legal sports betting partners. If you sign up or place a wager, FOX News may be compensated. This content was created by a team that works independently from the FOX newsroom.

Purdy was heard shouting, "Hey, Kyle!" with clear frustration, and the clip quickly found its way around social media. It appeared that Purdy wasn’t happy that Shanahan didn’t have the play-call in his ear in time.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE

San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan talks with Brock Purdy during the first quarter of the 49ers' 30-13 win over the New England Patriots at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara, Calif., on Sunday, Sept. 29, 2024.(San Francisco Chronicle)

Ahead of the 49ers’ matchup with theAtlanta Falconsthis week, Shanahan told a different story on the exchange.

"Yeah, it’s actually not to call a play faster," Shanahan replied when asked about it by a reporter. "It’s, ‘I need it again,’ and it gets cutoff at 15 [seconds]."

'WHAT THE F--K, CALL IT!': AARON RODGERS AND MIKE MCCARTHY CURSE AT EACH OTHER DURING HOT MIC MOMENT

Communications within a quarterback’s helmet can sometimes cause issues with getting play calls in on the sideline in time. That seemed to be the case here.

"Sometimes no one can hear it," Shanahan added. "… I always call a play and I just walk, and think. I don’t always watch the huddle. A lot of times. Mac [Jones] or someone will say, ‘We didn’t get it, it was chopped’ or somebody yells, ‘Brock’s yelling at you,’ which I can’t always hear. But I did hear him a couple times in this game, and I look up and try to do it again as long as it’s not past 15 seconds."

THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW!

San Francisco 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan watches from the sideline during the second half of an NFL football game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Tampa, Florida, on Oct. 12, 2025.(AP Photo/Chris O'Meara)

Shanahan is known as one of the best offensive play-callers in the sport, but it’s not always smooth sailing on game day. The clock is always playing a major factor, but the chemistry between play-caller and quarterback is what matters most.

title: California mayor insists cash handout program will solve affordability challenges, but critics question cost
author: ByJoshua Q. NelsonFox News
summary: Alameda Mayor Marilyn Ezzy Ashcraft told Fox News Digital the city's $4.6 million guaranteed income pilot worked, but federal ARPA funds ran dry.
content:
Alameda Mayor Marilyn Ezzy Ashcraft believes handing out cash will help people struggling with affordability with no clear answer to find sustainable funding.(Getty Images)

A California mayor insisted that handing out monthly cash payments is an effective tool to combat the state's soaring cost of living, even as local leaders face steep hurdles in securing permanent taxpayer funding to keepguaranteed income programsalive.

"I believe that guaranteed income programs like our Rise Up Alameda (RUA) pilot program are a valuable and effective tool to address the affordability crisis, based on the documented experiences of program participants," Alameda Mayor Marilyn Ezzy Ashcraft told Fox News Digital.

"The average age of the 150 program participants was 49 years, with 26% being 62 years or older, and most participants were either employed or retired."

Ashcraft’s comments follow the completion of Rise Up Alameda, the city's first-everguaranteed income pilot project. City staff presented the program's final 24-month evaluation report to the Alameda City Council on Oct. 6.

ALBUQUERQUE USES WEED TAX TO FUND 'NO-STRINGS-ATTACHED' GUARANTEED INCOME, SPARKING POLICY DEBATE

A guaranteed income pilot program in the City of Alameda, Calif., has ended.(Getty Images)

According tocity documents, the pilot aimed to "reduce economic instability for program participants, help to change local narratives and perceptions surrounding poverty and the provision of public benefits and help to support and inform the national discussion regarding public benefits and anti-poverty policies."

The Alameda City Council previously allocated $4.6 million in federal pandemic relief funds from the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) to finance the initiative, which provided 150 low-income households with $1,000 per month in no-strings-attached cash over two years. However, city notices confirm that because ARPA was a one-time federal allocation, the pilot has officially concluded, and the city has no plans or budget allocated for a permanent continuation.

"As mayor, I believe our responsibility is to advance practical, compassionate and evidence-informed policies that help residents meet their basic needs, preserve their dignity and build a more stable future for themselves and their families," Ashcraft told Fox News Digital when asked whether she planned to implement a permanent program.

BALTIMORE MAYOR BACKS BALLOT MEASURE CREATING TAXPAYER-FUNDED 'BABY FUND' FOR NEWBORN FAMILIES

Retail stores and traffic in the downtown area on Alameda Island, Alameda, Calif., Aug. 13, 2018.(Getty Images)

Ashcraft highlighted several personal accounts of local residents who received monthly payments through the pilot.

Among them was Andrea, a certified nursing assistant who used the funds to stay afloat following the death of her mother. The financial boost helped cover medical bills, rent, gas and Bay Area bridge tolls while allowing her to care for her father and ailing brother.

Another participant, Dolores, a retiree in her 70s living in affordable senior housing after a 41-year career at AT&T, used the extra $1,000 a month to pay off credit card debt and build an emergency savings account.

Other recipients included Haroon, a rideshare and transit driver; Julia, a woman with a disability who was able to buy new mattresses, groceries and a set of car tires after an eviction forced her to move in with her sister; and Tyronne, a Navy veteran and former truck driver at the decommissioned Alameda Naval Air Station who relied on the extra money to cover medical bills and stabilize his housing.

While Ashcraft praised these personal outcomes, she acknowledged that direct cash payments are not a full remedy for California's economic pressures.

"These stories demonstrate the value of direct, unrestricted cash in helping residents navigate financial hardship, maintain stability and improve their overall well-being," Ashcraft said.

"While guaranteed income is not a stand-alone solution to the affordability crisis, programs like Rise Up Alameda can provide meaningful support as we pursue longer-term solutions to the high cost of housing, health care, transportation and other basic needs."

GUARANTEED INCOME PROGRAM TARGETS LOW-INCOME HOMES LED BY BLACK MOMS AS CASH HANDOUTS SURGE NATIONWIDE

Street signs along the interstate in San Francisco show drivers directions to cities in the Bay Area and surrounding regions.(Getty Images)

Alameda's program underscores a funding challenge local governments face across the nation regarding how to sustain guaranteed income pilot programs now that temporary federal pandemic relief funding is ending.

Many local guaranteed income pilots were underwritten by temporary pandemic-era ARPA allocations. With federal deadlines requiring municipalities to spend remaining relief funds, mayors and advocacy groups are searching for ways to convert short-term experiments into permanent, taxpayer-funded government programs.

A major organization advocating for guaranteed income is the Economic Security Project (ESP). Founded in 2016 by a network of entrepreneurs, activists and researchers, ESP has helped support more than 100 guaranteed income pilots nationwide. California leads the country with more than 60 pilot launches.

ESP has urged governments to consider taxpayer-funded measures to establish permanent minimum-income guarantees.

When asked byFox News Digitalwhether local pilots are transitioning into permanent public policies, ESP indicated that multiple municipalities are actively working on legislative proposals.

"We can say, however, that there’s an active and growing movement for cash in hundreds of communities across the country," Shafeka Hashash, director of cash initiatives at the Economic Security Project, told Fox News Digital.

"We regularly take calls from some of the 1,500 members of the Guaranteed Income Community of Practice — researchers, nonprofits, local government officials and community leaders all interested in bringing cash to their neighborhoods," Hashash added.

"We just can’t announce any pilots or policies before the localities do."

MICHIGAN LAWMAKER MOVES TO SHUT DOWN 'GUARDRAIL-FREE' CASH HANDOUT PROGRAM FOR NEW MOTHERS

Former Stockton, California, Mayor Michael Tubbs founded Mayors for Guaranteed Income.(Rich Pedroncelli, File/AP Photo)

One pilot program has become permanent inCook County, Illinois. To sustain the initiative without federal aid, the Cook County Board of Commissioners approved $7.5 million for guaranteed income in the county budget, signaling a shift toward long-term local funding.

Republican state officials and conservative policy groups have sought toblock guaranteed income programs. Critics argue unconditional handouts discourage work, increase dependence on government assistance and misuse taxpayer funds.

"The affordability crisis is hitting Americans across backgrounds, geographies and party lines, and it's imperative that state and federal leaders adopt a solutions-focused approach," Mayors for Guaranteed Income founder Michael Tubbs told Fox News Digital.

CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP

"Banning policies that have proven effective at the local level is not only undemocratic, it is incredibly counterproductive to solving the key problem facing American families," he added.

"We should be unlocking innovation at the local level to boost economic security, stabilize households and restore faith in the American dream."

Joshua focuses on cultural trends,education, and public policy. He extensively covered reparations developments across the U.S., the Department of Education, and immigration issues.

title: Protests in Indonesia Demand Action to Stop Rainforest Fires
author: Muktita Suhartono
summary: Smoke from the blazes, blamed on destructive agricultural practices, has sickened hundreds of thousands and blanketed neighboring countries.
content:
Smoke from the blazes, blamed on destructive agricultural practices, has sickened hundreds of thousands and blanketed neighboring countries.

Thousands of protesters have taken to the streets this week in Indonesia to voice anger at what they see as their government’s failure to stop fires in rainforests that have blanketed their country in a sickening haze.

The demonstrations by students and members of civil society groups began on Monday and spread to more than a half dozen cities across the country including on the island of Borneo, where many of the fires are burning.

These are the latest in a series of protests that have been building since August, in which participants have demanded that the nation’s president, Prabowo Subianto, declare a national emergency and take steps to prevent destructive agricultural practices that many blame for fueling the blazes.

“I have the right to breathe,” read one banner at a rally in the Indonesian capital, Jakarta. “Extinguish the fires immediately!”

“The situation has reached a level that is completely, utterly abnormal,” said one protester, Naomi Artika, a law student at the University of Palangka Raya in Central Kalimantan, a province on Borneo.

Government leaders defended their response, which has not been able to halt the fires.

title: Drone Strike Kills More Than 150 in Abyei in Sudan’s Civil War
author: Matthew Mpoke Bigg
summary: Struggling against each other on the battlefield, the sides in Sudan’s civil war are relying on drones to strike across vast distances, inflicting huge tolls on civilians in the process.
content:
Struggling against each other on the battlefield, the sides in Sudan’s civil war are relying on drones to strike across vast distances, inflicting huge tolls on civilians in the process.

The drone attack struck a market without warning, sparking an inferno and sending oily smoke skyward. Those who could, scrambled to escape the heat. Many others stood no chance.

The attack on Monday on Amiet market in Abyei, a region disputed between Sudan and South Sudan and contested by the factions in Sudan’s civil war, caused particular shock because it hit a civilian area, rather than a military target.

More than 150 people were killed and the toll was likely to rise, according to Yohana Akol Ngor, the current minister of information in Abyei.

“What stood out was that bodies had been charred and reduced to ashes,” he said in an interview, adding that he had visited the market on Tuesday. “The victims were buried in two cemeteries.”

The medical charity Doctors Without Borders said that it was providing care to more than 20 people who had been wounded in the drone strikes, including several critical cases.

Local officials in Abyei blamed the Sudanese military for the attack, which South Sudan’s government condemned, summoning Sudan’s ambassador to the capital, Juba. A spokesman for the Sudanese military did not immediately reply to a request for comment.

title: Lula seeks tit-for-tat annulment of Bolsonaro election candidacy
author: AFP
summary: Lula seeks tit-for-tat annulment of Bolsonaro election candidacy
content:
BRASILIA: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva’s campaign requested the disqualification of right-wing rival Flavio Bolsonaro from the presidential race on Wednesday, a day after his opponent did the same.

Lula received 45 percent of the vote compared to Bolsonaro’s 47 percent in the first round earlier this month, and polls show a technical tie ahead of Sunday’s runoff.

Lula’s campaign is seeking to disqualify Bolsonaro over alleged election interference by tech giant Meta aimed at harming the incumbent’s chances of winning.

In a petition filed to Brazil’s top electoral court on Wednesday, Lula’s team requested Bolsonaro’s disqualification, citing his “abuse of economic power and improper use of social networks.”

Meta, which owns Facebook, WhatsApp and Instagram, denies the allegations but previously said that some of Lula’s campaign ads had been mistakenly deactivated due to technical errors.

Bolsonaro’s team requested Lula’s disqualification on Tuesday, accusing the leftist of “abuse of power” in the mass dissemination of government postings on WhatsApp during the campaign, according to the court filing.

title: Waseem Akhtar urges SHC CJ to take notice of 1,184 lawyers’ fake degree scandal at SALU
author: Rafay Hussain
summary: Waseem Akhtar urges SHC CJ to take notice of 1,184 lawyers’ fake degree scandal at SALU
content:
SUKKUR: Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) leader Waseem Akhtar on Thursday urged the chief justice of the Sindh High Court (SHC) to take notice of a fake degree scandal involving 1,184 lawyers after Shah Abdul Latif University (SALU), Khairpur, declared their academic records fake and enrolments invalid.

Addressing a press conference, Waseem Akhtar said the university’s inquiry committee had declared the academic records of 1,184 LLB candidates fake and illegal.

He demanded that the names of lawyers found to hold fake degrees be published in newspapers and criminal cases registered against them. He also called for action against those who allegedly facilitated the issuance of fraudulent degrees.

“If those responsible for dispensing justice hold fake degrees, who will deliver justice?” he asked.

Akhtar said the lawyers concerned had not only practised law in courts but had also participated in bar elections and cast their votes. He further claimed that between 2,500 and 3,000 lawyers were avoiding the verification and scrutiny of their degrees.

He urged Sindh Law Minister Zia-ul-Hassan Lanjar to take action in the matter, saying those responsible for maintaining the justice system must uphold fairness, transparency and accountability.

Criticising the PPP government, the MQM-P leader alleged that merit had been undermined across Sindh’s institutions and that nepotism had become widespread. He also accused the government of damaging educational institutions and called for merit to be ensured in the education and judicial sectors.

Akhtar further raised concerns over alleged irregularities at the University of Karachi’s law faculty, claiming that a junior lawyer had been appointed dean on the chief minister’s instructions in violation of the rules.

Read More: BISP warns public over fake recruitment advertisements

He also questioned the registration and licensing of lawyers, alleging that some were granted bar licences despite being registered in other districts of interior Sindh.

He warned that fraudulent degrees could increase the number of lawyers without ensuring professional competence and called on the authorities to protect educational standards from political interference, prejudice and ethnic divisions.

Meanwhile, SALU has declared the academic records of 1,184 LLB candidates fake and their enrolments and related credentials invalid.

The university has sent copies of the relevant notifications to the Higher Education Commission, Pakistan Bar Council and the provincial bar councils concerned. It has also uploaded details of the decisions on its website, saying the move aims to ensure transparency and keep the public informed.

title: Poverty drives woman to commit suicide in Lahore
author: Ahmer Khokhar
summary: Poverty drives woman to commit suicide in Lahore
content:
LAHORE: A 28-year-old woman allegedly died by suicide at her sister’s home in Lahore’s Iqbal Town on Thursday, with poverty and financial hardships reported as the reason.

According to Rescue 1122 officials, the deceased was identified as Ayesha Bibi.

The incident took place in Neelum Block near Number Stop in Iqbal Town, where Ayesha had been living with her sister.

According to initial reports, she had married a man named Rashid five years ago but later filed for khula (dissolution of marriage) due to financial difficulties. She subsequently moved to her sister’s home, where she reportedly continued to face financial hardships.

Ayesha was also employed at a small private company.

Police have recorded statements from family members and launched an investigation into the incident. Forensic experts collected evidence from the scene, while the body was shifted to a hospital for a post-mortem examination.

Her mobile phone has also been sent for forensic analysis. Police said the post-mortem report and mobile phone data would help establish the circumstances surrounding her death.

Poverty-stricken mother shoots two children before suicide

Earlier, in a shocking incident, a mother committed suicide after opening fire on her two children over poverty in Punjab’s Sheikhupura.

According to police, a 48-year-old mother named Shazia Imran, distressed by poverty, shot at her two children and committed suicide on Ghang Road, Sheikhupura.

As a result of the firing, 8-year-old son Ahsan Imran died, while 7-year-old daughter Tayyaba was injured.

Local residents said that the woman opened fire on her son and daughter after they asked her for money to buy snacks, and that the children’s father is a driver; their domestic situation was poor.

Poverty, domestic pressure behind Ichhra triple murder, says police

Earlier, in another case in Lahore, senior police officials said that poverty and domestic pressure were the main motives behind the Ichhra triple murder case, in which a mother allegedly killed her three children.

Three young siblings were found brutally murdered inside their home in the Ichhra area of Lahore.

Speaking to a YouTube channel, DSP Qamar Abbas of the Investigation Wing, Gulberg Lahore, said that during interrogation, poverty emerged as the primary motive. The family of seven was living in a small rented flat, while the husband’s monthly income was around Rs30,000, making it difficult to meet basic household needs.

The officer further said the husband allegedly pressured the wife to seek financial help from her parents, who were also poor. He added that tensions escalated after a dispute with the mother-in-law and verbal abuse from the husband.

Police also said the accused woman claimed she was subjected to severe domestic pressure and alleged mistreatment.

title: Musk threatens Democrats teeing up congressional probes
author: AFP
summary: Musk threatens Democrats teeing up congressional probes
content:
WASHINGTON: Elon Musk, President Donald Trump’s multi-billionaire ally, on Wednesday threatened Democrats who want to investigate alleged corruption and his role in the US government if they win control of Congress next month.

“Live by the sword, die by the sword,” Musk wrote on X, the social media platform he owns, in response to a Politico news article about Democrats’ plans to probe his activities if they win the midterm elections.

“Those who pick fights with me should understand that I will find out who is really pulling the strings and come for them, not just their puppets,” Musk added on the platform, which he regularly uses to promote conspiracy theories.

Musk, the United States’ first trillionaire, is a top financial contributor to Trump’s Republican Party, a frequent advisor to the president and a major recipient of government contracts through his SpaceX empire. He also controls the pioneering electric car company Tesla.

After helping to bankroll Trump’s return to power in the 2024 election, Musk ran a controversial project to slash US government spending and push nearly 300,000 employees out of work.

Republicans currently control the Senate and House of Representatives. However, Democrats are forecasted to win the lower chamber at least on November 3.

This would put Democrats in charge of powerful investigative committees, with power to compel testimony — and make Musk a prime target.

“The sheer number of conflicts of interest are astounding,” influential Democrat Zoe Lofgren was quoted as saying in Politico’s report.

title: Fraudster steals mobile phones worth Rs2.8 million after changing shop locks before closing

summary: Fraudster steals mobile phones worth Rs2.8 million after changing shop locks before closing
content:
KARACHI: A fraudster stole mobile phones and other goods worth Rs2.8 million from a shop in Karachi’s Saddar mobile market after replacing its locks shortly before closing time, according to reports.

The unusual theft was captured on video, which has stunned Saddar mobile market shopkeepers.

According to the details, the suspect arrived at the shop and stood there for some time before changing the locks just moments before the shop closed.

After the shopkeeper unknowingly locked up the shop with the altered locks and left, the suspect opened the shutter and fled with goods worth Rs2.8 million.

Trade leader Rizwan Irfan said the incident took place on the night of October 17. He said the suspect looted the shop in just five minutes before escaping.

A case has been registered at the Preedy police station, according to the report.

Foreign national among three sentenced to seven years in online investment fraud case

The investigation was conducted by Sub-Inspector Shehroz Riaz, the NCCIA said, adding that it remained committed to taking legal action against cybercrime suspects and protecting citizens.

title: China, Russia slam ‘destructive external interference’ in Eurasia
author: AFP
summary: China, Russia slam ‘destructive external interference’ in Eurasia
content:
BEIJING: Beijing and Moscow hit out on Thursday at “destructive external interference” in Eurasia, in a joint statement during a visit to Russia by Premier Li Qiang where he met President Vladimir Putin and Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin.

“The two sides pointed out that destructive external interference is the primary factor currently undermining stability across the Eurasian continent,” the joint statement published by Xinhua said.

“The two sides firmly condemn any acts of external coercion involving the use of force which are aimed at disrupting the process of Eurasian solidarity,” it added.

“Both sides will always firmly support each other on issues involving one another’s core interests and major concerns,” the statement also said.

“China supports Russia in safeguarding its security, stability, national unity, development and prosperity, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and opposes external forces’ interference in Russia’s internal affairs.”

The text made no reference to a mooted upcoming meeting between Putin and his Chinese and US counterparts Xi Jinping and Donald Trump.

“A possible first-ever meeting of the leaders of China, Russia and the United States… is being prepared,” Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov told reporters on Wednesday, adding that the aim was to include the meeting in the programme of the Asia-Pacific summit in Shenzhen, China next month.

title: Three killed, 10 injured including Pakistani in attacks on Dammam airport, Saudi Aramco facility
author: Hamid Ur Rehman
summary: Three killed, 10 injured including Pakistani in attacks on Dammam airport, Saudi Aramco facility
content:
DAMMAM: Three people were killed and 10 others injured in separate attacks targeting King Fahd International Airport in Dammam and a Saudi Aramco facility at the Shaybah oil field in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province, officials said.

According to a report by Saudi Gazette, one expatriate was killed and eight others injured in an attack on King Fahd International Airport on Wednesday evening, the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) announced.

The authority said the attack resulted in one fatality and eight injuries ranging from minor to severe. The injured were immediately transported to hospitals for medical treatment.

GACA confirmed that the incident also caused material damage, which was being assessed. Further updates would be issued as more information became available, it added.

Meanwhile, Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, spokesperson for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen, said coalition forces had intercepted and destroyed four drones in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province.

In a separate incident, two expatriates were killed and two others injured in a drone attack targeting a Saudi Aramco facility at the Shaybah oil field, the Ministry of Energy announced.

An official source at the ministry said Saudi air defences intercepted a drone attempting to target one of the oil field’s processing facilities.

The attempted attack sparked a fire in a vehicle belonging to a contractor working at the site, outside the facility’s perimeter. The incident did not affect operational activities, the source said.

The ministry confirmed that two expatriates, one Filipino and one Nepali national, were killed, while two others, a Pakistani and an Indian national, sustained injuries.

The relevant authorities responded immediately and took the necessary measures, the source added.

The ministry expressed condolences to the families of the deceased and wished the injured a speedy recovery.

title: Punjab invests £300,000 in Cholistan, Thal farming
author: Web Desk
summary: Punjab invests £300,000 in Cholistan, Thal farming
content:
The Government of Punjab has announced a climate-resilient agriculture project of £300,000 (12months) for dry desert areas of Cholistan and Thal that will foster climate change adaptation among farmers.

The pilot project is designed to insulate farming communities from climate shocks and reduce their exposure to climate extremes and help build forward-looking farmer resilience in Pakistan’s vulnerable desert ecosystems.

Project Scope & Duration: A 12 month targeted pilot project for climate adaptation in desert agriculture.

Provides proposed approaches to crop insurance and financial resilience to support farmers through crop losses and shocks that will result from climate change.

Core Framework: Merges methods for crop adaptation, digital farming advisory systems, early warning systems, up-to-date market access, and an integrated set of insurance systems.

The multi-sectoral project engages the major government agencies, technical experts and private partners:

Lead Government Partners: Planning & Development Department Punjab, Agriculture Department, and Environment Department, Punjab.

Implementation Agency:Punjab Agriculture Department.

Technical Lead:Asian Disaster Preparedness Center (ADPC).

Farmers and other actors from the beginning will be involved in a practical approach of field demonstrations on best practices of climate-smart farming.

Private Sector & Civil Society:Private businesses will be responsible for market access, value chain strengthening and value addition, while civil society and research organizations will lead community mobilization and evidence development.

The 1-year project timeline includes clear milestones, including the last two months for validation, institutional engagement, and the development of a scaling-up plan for multiple rollouts across arid areas in Punjab.

title: Pakistan receives only two Qatari LNG cargoes in October amid sharp drop in imports
author: Aleem Malik
summary: Pakistan receives only two Qatari LNG cargoes in October amid sharp drop in imports
content:
Pakistan received its second liquefied natural gas (LNG) cargo from Qatar on October 21, with the shipment docking at the Pakistan GasPort terminal, according to the provided details.

The first Qatari LNG cargo of October arrived at Port Qasim on October 13. This means Pakistan received only two LNG cargoes from Qatar during the month, compared with eight cargoes in October last year.

Pakistan’s LNG imports have also declined significantly since March. The country imported only 20 LNG cargoes during this period, compared with 72 cargoes received over the same period last year, according to a report.

The decline in LNG arrivals has also affected electricity generation from gas. Pakistan recorded a 56% decrease in electricity generation from LNG during September.

The reduced number of LNG cargoes and the fall in gas-based power generation indicate a significant decline in the country’s LNG imports compared with the previous year.

title: Argentina’s Milei calls Spain PM Sanchez a ‘dictator’ in Madrid visit
author: AFP
summary: Argentina’s Milei calls Spain PM Sanchez a ‘dictator’ in Madrid visit
content:
Argentina’s far-right President Javier Milei called Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez a “dictator” in a visit to Madrid on Wednesday, urging voters to oust the Socialist leader in upcoming elections.

It was yet another barb by Milei against his nemesis, which drew condemnation of “external interference, attacks and insults” from the Spanish government.

“You are suffering under the disgraceful dictator Pedro Sanchez,” Milei said at an economic forum in the Spanish capital, adding: “Kick the Socialists out, because you are the cradle of liberalism.”

Sanchez has emerged as a global progressive star, notably for his clashes with US President Donald Trump and Israel, but his eight-year premiership is in peril ahead of the November 29 general election.

The main opposition conservative Popular Party (PP) is predicted to win the most seats but without obtaining a majority, potentially giving far-right Vox the decisive say in forming the next government.

Milei also referred to Sanchez as a “thief” and “corrupt”, as the Spanish leader grapples with graft probes that have affected relatives and ex-Socialist heavyweights.

Sanchez has consistently defended the probity of his government and the source of his party’s funding.

The Spanish foreign ministry slammed Milei for his “external interference, attacks and insults” against Sanchez and his “call for the use of violence”.

“It is shameful that a person who holds the highest office of a sister nation makes visits to our country with the only aim of trying to foster a climate of polarisation and violence,” the ministry said in a statement.

The Socialists have used Milei in campaigning to rally left-wing voters against what they call a “reactionary international”, including the Argentine leader’s swingeing cuts to public spending, symbolised by a chainsaw.

Sanchez took pride from Milei’s latest attack during a campaign rally in the northern city of Burgos on Wednesday, contrasting Spain’s strong economic growth and social measures with cuts in Argentina.

“The chainsaws and cuts that the right and the far right always make when they govern build nothing, rather they destroy… They don’t make our country or our economy grow, they sink them,” Sanchez said.

Milei did not meet Sanchez during his visit — the latest of several unofficial trips to Spain which he has used to attack its leftist government and rally with the right-wing opposition.

The self-described “anarcho-capitalist” instead saw figures from Vox as well as Isabel Diaz Ayuso, the PP leader of the Madrid region who is an acerbic critic of Sanchez.

Milei hailed Vox’s leader Santiago Abascal and Ayuso as “friends” during his speech in Madrid, saying “they have sound, positive ideas for pulling Spain out of its decline”.

The firebrand libertarian also held a video call with Abascal during which they joked about the insults against Sanchez and the reaction, according to footage posted to social media.

In 2024, a diplomatic crisis erupted after Milei called Sanchez’s wife Begona Gomez “corrupt”, prompting Madrid to recall its ambassador to Argentina for months.

title: Pakistan and Kenya celebrate bilateral ties through photography exhibition
author: Web Desk
summary: Pakistan and Kenya celebrate bilateral ties through photography exhibition
content:
A photography exhibition showcasing the landscapes, wildlife and cultural heritage of Pakistan and Kenya has highlighted efforts to strengthen ties between the two countries through cultural diplomacy.

The exhibition, organised in collaboration with the Pakistan Africa Economic Council and participating photographers, presented images reflecting the natural beauty and cultural diversity of both nations.

Pakistan’s Federal Minister for National Heritage and Culture, Aurangzeb Khan Khichi, praised the initiative, saying it provided an opportunity to promote mutual understanding and showcase the country’s artistic talent internationally.

He said the exhibition provided an opportunity to strengthen cultural understanding between Pakistan and Kenya and acknowledged the contribution of the Kenyan High Commissioner and international partners, including UNESCO and the United Nations.

He expressed hope that a similar exhibition featuring Pakistani photography would be organised abroad to highlight Pakistan’s cultural heritage.

Addressing the gathering, Kenya’s High Commissioner to Pakistan, Lieutenant General (Retired) Peter Mbogo Njiru, described the event as a celebration of friendship and shared human experiences. He said photography could overcome geographical and linguistic barriers and bring people closer through a shared appreciation of nature and culture.

The high commissioner highlighted Kenya’s tourism attractions, including wildlife safaris, coastal beaches, mountains, forests and lakes. He drew comparisons with Pakistan’s mountains and valleys, saying both countries had opportunities to promote tourism and cultural exchange.

He also called for stronger cooperation in tourism, culture, youth engagement and people-to-people exchanges, alongside existing ties in trade, investment, education and agriculture.

He invited Pakistani citizens, members of the diplomatic community and international visitors to discover Kenya’s natural beauty and hospitality.

Pakistan Africa Economic Council General Secretary Sheikh Rashid Alam welcomed the exhibition and called for stronger cultural and economic cooperation between Pakistan and African countries, inviting African nations to work jointly with Pakistan.

Photographer Dr Usman-ul-Haq thanked the Pakistan National Council of the Arts and other institutions for supporting the exhibition, while National Assembly member Ikhtiar Baig called for greater government facilitation to expand Pakistan’s engagement with African nations.

title: CD Projekt Red releases Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 update with new quests
author: Kumail Shah
summary: CD Projekt Red releases Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 update with new quests
content:
CD Projekt Red isn’t finished with Night City. After recently updating The Witcher 3’s visuals, the studio has released patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5, called the Edgerunners 2 Update. This patch arrives alongside the Netflix debut of all ten episodes of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, which premiered on October 20.

This patch finally brings one of the game’s most requested features: weapon dual-wielding. Players who unlock the Double Trouble perk in the Cool skill tree can use two Power pistols or revolvers at once, with four new combat perks to support this. Cyberware customization also gets a big upgrade with five new Glamdoc shops around the map, where players can add unique cosmetic skins to arm hardware like Mantis Blades and Gorilla Arms.

The update adds cross-platform mod support through mod.io. Players on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S can now browse and install community mods right from the game menu. Console players should remember that using a modded save will turn off achievements and trophies.

The patch adds two new story experiences. The side quest Clampdown serves as a prequel to the anime and rewards players with a five-piece gear set inspired by King. Another mission, Welcome to Paradise, offers a guided tour of Night City with narration by Richard Night. Players can also find 12 new Minor Arcana tarot cards, collect new clothes and hairstyles, and listen to a radio station featuring music from the show.

Update 2.5 adds support for Nvidia DLSS 4.5, which offers up to 6X Multi Frame Generation. AMD FSR options are now simpler, keeping FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation while removing older versions. Console players now have an FOV slider, better HDR, ray tracing improvements, and performance boosts for the PS5 Pro. Samsung Odyssey displays that are compatible also get glasses-free 3D support.

The patch also brings quality-of-life improvements like save grouping by playthrough, stash filters, and new Photo Mode tools. The update launches on October 22 for PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. Releases for Nintendo Switch 2 and the Mac App Store will follow soon after.
